capabilities: jump to the first or last line of the note and center it on screen
trigger jumps from commands, hotkeys, ribbon buttons, or the mobile toolbar
show a floating arrow button while scrolling that taps to jump
toggle ribbon buttons and the floating button in settings
open hotkey settings pre-filled for each command
extras: Manual installation only; no community plugin store install described. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in one-tap way to reach the start or end of a long note while editing, especially on mobile where scrolling is slow.
summary: Navigation helper that jumps the cursor to the top or bottom of the current note via commands, ribbon buttons, or a floating scroll button.
